head: b9391b199ef38d7bf5066b6cd81d21b283a3a4e1
note: Law-1 parking lot. Nothing here was dropped; each item states why it is parked rather than filed.

items.title: CAND-03 REFUTED — `skipCurrent()` is unwired, but no cursor pin is reachable, so there is nothing to back-stop
items.reasoning: The orchestrator's CAND-03 is factually correct that `skipCurrent` occurs exactly once in the whole script tree, at DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:376 inside the MIGRATE_CHUNK NatSpec, is never called, and is not declared on the script's migrator interface. It does NOT follow that a pin is reachable. Reading MigratorV2V3.migrate (lib/phlimbo-ea/src/MigratorV2V3.sol:172-211) at pin f279c62: the only per-user statements outside the try/catch are `users[i]`, a `phlimboV2.userInfo(user)` staticcall and a cached `phlimboV3.MINIMUM_STAKE()` read hoisted above the loop — none can revert on a per-user basis — and every remaining path (zero, sub-MINIMUM_STAKE dust, reverting position) `continue`s or is absorbed by the try/catch, so the cursor advances unconditionally and `migrateIterator` reaches -1. The full phlimbo-ea V3-M-04 record (fingerprint 95552867719d92a5...) was read rather than inferred from its title: its two originally-unskippable revert vectors were closed by phlimbo stories 026/028, and the surviving residual recorded in `proposedStatusChange_phlimbo_ea_09` is OUT-OF-GAS only, explicitly documented as a scope limitation handled by the skipCurrent backstop. The proposal to mark V3-M-04 fixed has NOT been applied, so the entry is legitimately still open — but the vector it now carries is not a pin.
items.residual: The real Phase 4e failure mode is skip accumulation -> `totalStaked() != 0` -> the hard gate at :1779 aborts the run. Per ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast (run-23) that abort happens during forge's local pass, before any transaction is dispatched, so it is atomic and costs nothing on chain. That is a liveness/operational footgun, not asset risk, and the substantive part of it is filed as PR24-05 (the unchecked V2-mint precondition that could CAUSE the skips). The unwired `skipCurrent` docstring is a documentation nit at most and is not filed separately.
items.forHuman: If phlimbo-ea V3-M-04 is ever re-graded such that a pin becomes reachable again, re-open this: Phase 4e has no in-band recovery and would require a hand-sent skipCurrent outside the script.

items.title: The phUSD minter candidate set can only see 20 compile-time addresses plus the 15 new contracts; a grant to anything else is invisible
items.reasoning: `_phusdMinterCandidates()` (:897-922) is a fixed 20-entry `pure` set and `_requireNotPhusdMinter` sweeps the 15 runtime deployments. A phUSD mint grant issued to any address outside those 35 — an EOA, a future contract — moves neither the mask nor the sweep, so the 'nothing else moved' half of the two-sided delta is scoped to a whitelist, not to the minter set. This is inherent to the design story 075 shipped and story 076 did not change it. Not filed as new; recorded so the control's true scope is on the record rather than implied to be exhaustive.
items.forHuman: Closing this properly needs an enumerable minter set on phUSD (a `MinterGranted`/`MinterRevoked` event scan, or an on-chain enumerable set), which is a FlaxToken change, not a script change.

items.title: `forge script` emits fatal-looking `Unable to resolve imports` errors for `script/FixBalancerPoolerMainnet.s.sol` despite foundry.toml's `skip` list
items.disposition: parked — non-fatal, environment-adjacent, needs one more datapoint before filing
items.reasoning: Every `promotion-ready:dry` invocation logs two red ERROR lines and an `Unable to resolve imports:` block naming `@yield-claim-nft/dispatchers/BalancerPooler.sol` and `@yield-claim-nft/NFTMinter.sol` in `script/FixBalancerPoolerMainnet.s.sol` — files that story-039's flatten refactor removed from the submodule and that are genuinely absent at pin 9c18020 in the READ-ONLY lib/ tree as well. `foundry.toml` skips that file (with a comment saying its breakage predates the current work), and `forge build` is clean, but `forge script` prints the resolution failure anyway and then proceeds. So it is noise, not a break. It is recorded because a red ERROR block at the head of a Ledger cutover run is exactly the kind of thing an operator learns to scroll past, and the next genuine resolution failure would look identical.
items.forHuman: If a future forge version promotes this to fatal, `promotion-ready:broadcast` stops working. Cheap fix: delete the three dead V1-era scripts the skip list names, rather than skipping them.

items.title: Progress file is stamped during the local pass; story 076 raises the guard from 50 to 60 keys and adds a second write-once baseline, widening an already-known blast radius
items.disposition: parked — dedups into existing ledger L-03 `ea648ec5ea`
items.reasoning: `_trackConfig`/`_trackDeployment` call `_writeProgressFileWithStatus` immediately (:3006, :3014) whenever `!isPreview`, and forge executes the whole script body locally before dispatching, so a run that aborts at the :1779 gate still leaves a progress file naming a PhlimboV3 and a MigratorV2V3 that were never created and marking `p4e_setMigrator`/`p4e_migrate`/`p4e_v2_revokeMigrator` as done. Story 076 adds 10 such keys. The subsequent `:resume` is documented as requiring a HAND-TRIMMED progress file, and the phantom-address case degrades loudly (`_isDeployed("PhlimboV3")` is true, then `IOwnable(newPhlimboV3).owner()` reverts against an address with no code), so it fails closed. This is the same mechanism as ledger L-03 `ea648ec5ea` and verify-side `5c6d2c9e3b`; filing it again on the same root cause would be a duplicate. Recorded so the widened key count is attached to those entries.
items.forHuman: Worth attaching to L-03 as a scope note at triage rather than opening a new entry.

items.title: PhlimboV1 (0x3984eBC8...) still reports totalStaked 13,615,682e15 after the story-049 V1->V2 migration completed
items.disposition: parked — out of this entry point's closure
items.reasoning: Observed incidentally while verifying the view layer for PR24-06. The V1->V2 migrator 0xb50CaF00... reads `migrateIterator() == -1` and `userCount() == 19`, i.e. its pass completed, yet PhlimboV1 still reports `totalStaked() == 13615682000000000000000` — a similar order of magnitude to V2's 13095559131012692364262. That may be stranded stake, or an un-decremented accumulator, or simply users who never migrated. Either way the root cause lives in story 049 / phlimbo-ea, not in story 076 or this script, and grading it would mean expanding scope beyond the manifest's closure.
items.forHuman: Recommend a separate `/analyze` or a targeted recheck against phlimbo-ea rather than folding it into this script audit. Flagged here rather than dropped because a non-empty V1 is a plausible user-funds question.

items.title: Conservation relaxation `v3Staked >= phlimboV2StakedAtCutover` — NOT re-filed
items.reasoning: Story 076 lines 896-901, Human-Confirmed 2026-08-04T00:50:10Z: 'The [medium] non-blocking finding (conservation assertion relaxed to `v3Staked >= phlimboV2StakedAtCutover`) was reviewed and accepted by the human: the cutover broadcast runs for a matter of minutes with the UI paused, and there is no MEV incentive to mask diverted stake with a direct V3 deposit inside that window. The load-bearing `require(phlimboV2.totalStaked() == 0)` completeness gate is unaffected.' I found no new basis. The dry run reproduced exact equality (V3 totalStaked == the V2 baseline == 13095559131012692364262), so the `>=` slack was not exercised, and PR24-04 concerns the gate's ORDERING, not its strength — it does not disturb the accepted rationale.

items.title: Dedup provenance — an unconditional `-PhlimboV2` summary line rides inside PR24-01 rather than carrying its own label
items.disposition: not parked, not dropped — preserved in-band inside PR24-01; recorded here so it cannot be lost if a report renders titles only
items.reasoning: PR24-01's evidence and recommendation fields carry a SECOND, structurally distinct instance of the same class: the cutover summary block prints `phUSD minter-set DELTA (story 076): +PhlimboV3, -PhlimboV2. Nothing else moved.` unconditionally on every run, including a broadcast, even though the same run's own Phase 0 output reads `V2 holds phUSD mint: false` and `membership mask: 270080` — so the `-PhlimboV2` half is a no-op the log asserts happened. VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol:259-263 prints a correct conditional NOTE for the same fact, so the deploy log and the verify log disagree with each other about whether a revoke occurred. Its remediation (make the line conditional on `phusdMinterMaskAtPhase0 & (1 << PHUSD_MINTER_BIT_PHLIMBO_V2) != 0`) is separate from PR24-01's own fix (add `require(!v2.paused())` to Phase 7).
items.dedupAction: NOT split. Splitting a finding into two is not a dedup authority — dedup removes and consolidates, it does not mint. Flagged in deduplicated-findings.json as FR-24-01 for the severity-classifier / report-writer to rule on, and preserved verbatim inside PR24-01 so it survives either ruling.
items.forHuman: If PR24-01 is graded and written up on its pause leg alone, this second leg needs its own QA line — it is a log-consistency defect on the broadcast path, not a comment nit.
